scope: One compiled aarch64 scalar u64/[u64;4] getter instance; not a general performance claim.
observations: LLVM inlines the table find into the scalar Map getter and forwards the matched cached word and row address; there is no second control-word load on success.
A successful-slot comparison against control length remains before returning the value.
PackedIndexMap was left unchanged; CompactIndexMap uses one shared fused lookup for both width policies, with its own always-wide control.
decision: Do not attribute the read regression to a source-level reload eliminated by the compiler. Test smaller control words as a separate hypothesis; no cache-miss cause or speed improvement is established by disassembly alone.
